[00:14:22] Q: How long have you been doing land work?
A: Fourteen years now. Started in 2012 doing ranch
splits out past Hondo, moved into mineral and
surface severance work about four years in.

[00:31:07] A: The parcel database is mine. I built it,
I host it, I run the nightly pull myself.

[00:52:41] Q: Team size on the Atascosa cycle?
A: Three of us. Me, a title clerk, and a surveyor
on contract.
